title: SentinelScan Report Export -- Common Definitions (v1, DRAFT)
description: Shared $defs used by discover.schema.json and operate.schema.json. Not a standalone envelope on its own -- see README.md.

identifierType.description: Validation/normalization hint only -- not persisted on Asset today. See README.md decision #5.

signature.description: Used for Threat Reference Correlation (Section 12.5) against ThreatReferenceEntry.signature. All fields optional -- most Findings won't match a known entry.

asset_ref.description: Report-local identifier, referenced by findings[].asset_ref. Not a Cloud primary key -- see README.md decision #6.

identifier.description: Maps directly to Asset.identifier (String(255)). An IP or hostname, used as the reconciliation key across reports.

extensions.description: Open, producer-specific bag (e.g. open ports, OS fingerprint). additionalProperties intentionally true -- see README.md decision #2.

finding_ref.description: Report-local identifier. Not a Cloud primary key and not used as a correlation fingerprint -- see README.md decisions #6-7.

asset_ref.description: Must match exactly one assets[].asset_ref in the same export.

title.description: Maps to Finding.title (String(500)). Oversized input is rejected, not truncated -- see README.md decision #4.

description.description: Maps to Finding.description (Text, no DB limit). 100k cap here is a sanity/DoS guard only, not a modeled product limit.

cve_ids.description: Shared field, not edition-specific -- see README.md decision #8.

first_observed_at.description: Informational only -- Cloud computes its own new/resolved/recurring correlation state in Stage 3 (Section 12.1), it does not trust this field for that.

evidence.description: Open, producer-specific bag (ports, banners, log excerpts, runtime context). additionalProperties intentionally true -- see README.md decision #2.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. See README.md decision #3 for the versioning contract.

export_id.description: Producer-generated, for producer-side traceability/support only -- not Cloud's Report.id.

assets.description: An export with zero assets is not meaningful -- at least one is required.

findings.description: Zero findings is valid (a clean scan).
